userSpecifiedSources: NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4 (G02135, doi:10.7265/a98x-0f50); NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory CO2, CH4, N2O and SF6 trends (gml.noaa.gov/ccgg/trends, with Scripps Institution of Oceanography for Mauna Loa CO2); NOAA OISST v2.1 daily 0.25-degree SST via NOAA PSL (psl.noaa.gov), cross-checked against NCEI. Built daily by scripts/build.py in https://github.com/yasumorishima/earth-vital-signs, which publishes nothing unless every check passes.

sea_ice_extent_daily.csv.description: Daily sea ice extent for each hemisphere from the NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4.

columns.extent_mkm2: Sea ice extent in million square kilometres (area with at least 15% ice concentration)
columns.missing_mkm2: Area with missing satellite data, million square kilometres (0 on almost all days)
columns.extent_5day_mean_mkm2: Trailing 5-day mean of extent as used in NSIDC charts; empty where the 5 previous days are not all present (every-other-day era before 1987-08)

co2_daily_mauna_loa.csv.description: Daily mean atmospheric CO2 at Mauna Loa Observatory (NOAA GML); days without valid measurements are absent.

columns.decimal_date: Date as a decimal year, as published by NOAA GML
columns.co2_ppm: Daily mean CO2 mole fraction, parts per million (dry air)

greenhouse_gases_monthly.csv.description: Monthly greenhouse gas averages from NOAA GML in long format (one row per series and month).

columns.series: co2_mlo (Mauna Loa, ppm), co2_global (ppm), ch4_global (ppb), n2o_global (ppb) or sf6_global (ppt)
columns.date: First day of the month, YYYY-MM-DD
columns.average: Monthly mean in the series' unit; empty where NOAA reports missing
columns.deseasonalized: Monthly value with the average seasonal cycle removed, as published by NOAA GML
columns.interpolated: co2_mlo only, from 1974-05: True where NOAA filled a missing month by interpolation (negative stdev in the source file); empty for other series and for the Scripps months before 1974-05

sst_daily.csv.description: Daily area-weighted mean sea surface temperature computed from NOAA OISST v2.1 (0.25 degree, cos-latitude weights, ocean cells only).

columns.world_60s_60n: Mean SST between 60S and 60N, degrees Celsius
columns.world_60s_60n_anom_1991_2020: world_60s_60n minus its 1991-2020 mean for the same calendar day (Feb 29 uses Feb 28), degrees Celsius
columns.north_atlantic_0_60n_0_80w_anom_1991_202: North Atlantic mean minus its 1991-2020 mean for the same calendar day, degrees Celsius
